subject: Fix issue of listen before chmod on Unix sockets (CVE-2023-45145) (#12671)
reason: The change only reorders chmod() before listen() in anetUnixServer (CVE-2023-45145), closing a microsecond-scale startup race where the Unix socket briefly listened with umask-default permissions before unixsocketperm was applied. TCP callers pass perm=0 and the chmod is guarded to AF_LOCAL, so no other path changes. The steady-state behaviour is identical on both builds: same replies, same final socket mode, no effect on replication, persistence, cluster, or tools, so a compared sequence has no command whose reply could differ (every expect_difference would be unreached-change).
